title: Frank Joshua breaks down barriers with emotionally provoking single “Walls”
htmlContent: Frank Joshua's latest single, "Walls," takes listeners on a heartfelt journey through the ups and downs of relationships, and self-discovery. The song comes in two versions, a longer storytelling version and a shorter radio-friendly edit, both invite us to think about the quiet struggles that often go unspoken as we grow older. "Walls" focuses on the challenges of maintaining relationships over time, highlighting the hidden difficulties that can arise as partners evolve together. Joshua's voice delivers raw emotion, reflecting someone who has truly lived and understood these experiences. The music enhances the lyrics, creating a rhythm that mirrors the flow of our connections with others. https://open.spotify.com/album/4fr3EK1Ckbs9SL6RKXrove While the radio edit gives a quick taste of what the song is about, the full-length version allows Joshua's story to unfold. Some might find the longer version tricky to stay focused on, but for those who take the time, "Walls" offers a deeper and more rewarding experience. "Walls" is a thoughtful reflection on the complexities of lasting relationships, making it a significant and moving listen for everyone. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
